title: Van Reede's cipher letters to Princess Wilhelmina, Berlin 1789-95 (KHA A32-545-548)

documents.shelfmark: Koninklijk Huisarchief, The Hague, A32 Wilhelmina, inv. A32-545, -546, -547 (37 glossed pages)

plaintext.source: Contemporary decipherment written over the cipher runs.

transcription.source: KHA renditions (original size), pairs_a.txt and pairs_b.txt
transcription.notes: Measured file pairs_a.txt holds PT, CT and AL lines; about 1,900 cipher groups in both files.

system.summary: Mixed nomenclator of about 850 numbers: syllables, words and names in topical blocks; marks on single digits (underlines under a given digit, primes) select plural or variant forms; an overlined 3 marks names.
system.notes: The 1792-95 solid pages use a third code.

conditions.human_role: Lead chosen by the user from the KHA sweep; user asked to rebuild the code and try it on R1893 and the 1792-95 pages.

solution.what: KHA K8 survey: thumbnails of A32-542-549 flagged; 37 glossed 1789-92 pages and 10 solid 1792-95 pages listed.
Two agents transcribed the 37 glossed pages with marks and digit positions (pairs_a.txt, pairs_b.txt).
Vote table from the aligned runs (table.py): 386 numbers, 242 with >=60% agreement; mark rules worked out (underline position = plural/variant, prime = second entry).
Table applied to R1893 (vanreede1787, Dutch, 24 Mar 1793): 40% coverage, chance level, French values in a Dutch letter; marks above digits, not under. Not this code.
R1024 Grand Chiffre and the table under every offset -2000..2000 on the first 23 groups of the 17 Jan 1792 solid page: nonsense (best 9/23).
47 'numbers in text' pages transcribed with clear context (unglossed_a.txt, unglossed_b.txt; 150 runs, about 1,100 groups): 8 without cipher, nearly all runs on the rest glossed at the time.
Held-out test of the vote table on the newly transcribed glossed runs: 62% of confident decoded values found in the run's own gloss vs 10% in an unrelated run's (159 runs, 456 values).
DP alignment of the new glossed runs anchored on table values, 2-fold retrain: held-out precision unchanged (64% -> 63%). Not kept.
Table applied to the six partly glossed remainders (170524, 170701, 170885, 170946, 171240): no readable text; 171240 agrees with its gloss at both ends (Bischofswerder ... hazarder).

outcome.method_basis: Work in progress: the 1789-92 code table is rebuilt from contemporary interlinear decipherments; R1893 and the 1792-95 solid pages are in other codes with no key.
outcome.notes: The 1789-92 letters were deciphered at the time (interlinear glosses on nearly every run); the table rebuilt here scores 62% held-out precision (10% chance). R1893 and the 1792-95 solid pages are in other codes.
